summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology specializing in deep learning for on-device perception. Built object detection and semantic segmentation pipelines — YOLOv8, YOLO11n, U-Net — deploying TensorRT inference at ~18 FPS on NVIDIA Jetson; experienced in data curation for perception training sets and benchmarking accuracy-latency trade-offs under low-power constraints.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom toothbrush detection dataset for health-level classification using YOLOv8.
Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: Research Fellow
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones on the BraTS 2020 MRI dataset; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU; reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error; built full inspection pipeline using custom image stitching and wavelet denoising.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom dataset; improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via preprocessing and model tuning.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated data generation pipelines using CARLA's semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18) with SoftmaxFocalLoss + ParsingRelationLoss; integrated into an adaptive control stack with lane-following and waypoint fallback.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Deployed TensorRT YOLO at ~18 FPS on NVIDIA Jetson for real-time visual servoing; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) with dual ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing, constant memory for weights/biases, and preallocated global buffers.
Coalesced kernel: 49.2ms vs 73.3ms (uncoalesced) and 77.5ms (CPU TorchScript) — ~35% speedup with identical image classification accuracy.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory by ~55% via 8-bit quantization on TinyLlama 1.1B; <1% accuracy degradation across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC — near-lossless for on-device deployment.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
